# HAT Styling Guide

## 1. CSS Architecture Overview

HAT uses **CSS Modules (SCSS)** for component styling. Each widget has its own SCSS module file. Styles are scoped to prevent conflicts between widgets.

**File structure:**

```
src/styles/
├── globals.scss                        # CSS Variables, reset, typography, .gridContainer, dark mode
├── breakpoints.scss                    # Breakpoint variables
├── icons.scss                          # Icon font mixin
├── buttonsMixins.scss                  # Button style mixins
└── WidgetName/
    └── WidgetName.module.scss          # Per-widget styles
```

---

## 2. CSS Variables System

All design tokens are CSS custom properties defined on `:root` in `globals.scss`:

```scss
/* Fonts */
--font-primary: 'SerifFont', serif;
--font-primary-sans: 'SansFont', sans-serif;
--font-icons: project-icons;

/* Typographic scale (weight size/line-height family) */
--h48-72: 700 4.8rem/1.5 var(--font-primary-sans);   /* Largest heading */
--h38-57: 700 3.8rem/1.5 var(--font-primary-sans);
--h28-42: 700 2.8rem/1.5 var(--font-primary-sans);
--h20-30: 700 2rem/1.5   var(--font-primary-sans);
--h18-27: 700 1.8rem/1.5 var(--font-primary-sans);
--p20-30: 400 2rem/1.5   var(--font-primary);         /* Body text large */
--p17-25: 700 1.7rem/1.5 var(--font-primary-sans);
--p17-25s:400 1.7rem/1.5 var(--font-primary-sans);
--p15-22: 400 1.5rem/1.5 var(--font-primary);
--p13-19: 400 1.3rem/1.5 var(--font-primary);
--p13-19s:700 1.3rem/1.5 var(--font-primary-sans);
--p10-12: 400 1rem/1.25  var(--font-primary);         /* Smallest text */

/* Brand colors */
--colorPrimary: #XXXXXX;
--colorText: #XXXXXX;
--white: #FFFFFF;
--bodyBg: #ffffff;

/* Spacing */
--ringGap: 1.6rem;
--ringGapLg: 3.4rem;
--containerPadding: 1.6rem;
--containerPaddingLg: 2.5rem;
```

**Important:** `html { font-size: 62.5% }` → `1rem = 10px`. All sizes use rem.

---

## 3. Breakpoints

```scss
@import "../breakpoints";

$breakpoint-sm: 510px;
$breakpoint-md: 768px;    // Mobile/Desktop boundary
$breakpoint-lg: 1024px;
$breakpoint-xl: 1440px;

$breakpoint-xs-max: $breakpoint-sm - 1px;   // 509px
$breakpoint-sm-max: $breakpoint-md - 1px;   // 767px
$breakpoint-md-max: $breakpoint-lg - 1px;   // 1023px
$breakpoint-lg-max: $breakpoint-xl - 1px;   // 1439px
```

**Mobile-first approach:** Write base styles for mobile, then add `@media (min-width: $breakpoint-*)` for larger screens.

Grid behavior: On mobile (<768px), all columns stack vertically at 100% width.

---

## 4. CSS Module Pattern

Each widget gets `src/styles/WidgetName/WidgetName.module.scss`:

```scss
@import "../breakpoints";

// Doubled class name for specificity boost
.MyWidget.MyWidget {
    &:global {
        // Styles for child classes generated by hat-ring-components
        > .Title {
            font: var(--h20-30);
            color: var(--colorText);
        }

        .Image {
            width: 100%;
        }
    }

    @media (min-width: $breakpoint-md) {
        // Desktop overrides
    }
}

// Reversed pattern – style when inside another context
.MyWidget { :global & { } }
```

**Key rules:**

- Root class name must be **PascalCase** matching the component name
- Double the class name (`.MyWidget.MyWidget`) for specificity boost
- Wrap child classes in `&:global { }` — CSS Modules would otherwise mangle them
- One directory per widget
- Large widgets may split into sub-files imported from the main module

---

## 5. Three-Layer CSS Variable Fallback (for portable widgets)

Widgets that may be moved to hat-ring-components should use this pattern:

```scss
.MyWidget.MyWidget {
    &:global {
        .Title {
            // Layer 1: widget-specific token (set by project override)
            // Layer 2: global design token (from globals.scss)
            // Layer 3: hardcoded fallback
            color: var(--myWidgetTitleColor, var(--colorPrimary, currentColor));
            font: var(--myWidgetTitleFont, var(--h18-27, bold 1.8rem/1.5 sans-serif));
        }
    }
}
```

Project override sets the widget-specific token:

```scss
// Project-level override
.MyWidget.MyWidget {
    &:global {
        --myWidgetTitleColor: var(--colorSecondary);
    }
}
```

---

## 6. Overriding hat-ring-components Widget Styles

```scss
// src/styles/BasicWidget/BasicWidget.module.scss
@import "../breakpoints";
// Optionally import the base styles:
// @import "hat-ring-components/src/styles/BasicWidget/BasicWidget.module";

.BasicWidget.BasicWidget {
    &:global {
        background-color: var(--backgroundGrey);
        --basicWidgetLinkColor: var(--colorPrimary);

        > .Title {
            font: var(--h28-42);
            margin-bottom: var(--ringGap);
        }
    }
}
```

Register in `src/cssModules.ts`:

```ts
import basicWidget from './styles/BasicWidget/BasicWidget.module.scss';

export const cssModules = {
    BasicWidget: basicWidget.BasicWidget,
};
```

---

## 7. Icons

```scss
@import "../icons";

.MyElement {
    @include icon(after, arrow-right);   // ::after pseudo-element
    @include icon(before, search);       // ::before pseudo-element
}
```

The icon mixin adds `font-family: var(--font-icons)` and the correct character code to the pseudo-element.

---

## 8. Button Mixins

```scss
@import "../buttonsMixins";

.MyButton {
    @include btnPrimaryBig();     // Large primary button
    @include btnPrimarySmall();   // Small primary button
}
```

---

## 9. Dark Mode

Dark mode is handled via CSS custom properties. Override color tokens in a `prefers-color-scheme` or class-based media query:

```scss
:root {
    --bodyBg: #ffffff;
    --colorText: #333333;
}

// If project uses dark mode:
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root {
        --bodyBg: #1a1a1a;
        --colorText: #e0e0e0;
    }
}
```

---

## 10. Common Patterns

**Grid container styling:**

```scss
.gridContainer {
    max-width: $breakpoint-xl;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 var(--containerPadding);

    @media (min-width: $breakpoint-lg) {
        padding: 0 var(--containerPaddingLg);
    }
}
```

**Image handling:**

```scss
.Image {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;   // Prevent layout shift
    object-fit: cover;
}
```

**Truncation:**

```scss
.Title {
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
}
```

---

## 11. Rules

**Don't:** padding/colors/fonts on root element (project-level override) · `!important` (use doubled class) · pixel values (use rem) · hardcoded colors (use variables) · format API class names.

**Do:** functional layout only (columns, grid, flex) · CSS variables for visual properties · mobile-first media queries.
